The update is u <- u - KT_rho - lam * R^T(Ru-g)/dc_norm (solver lines 141-156): with lam ~= 0.0023 the data-consistency pull is negligible vs the learned regulariser gradient KT_rho, so the VN converges to a blunt smoother that degrades the FBP init below baseline. LIMITER = DC weight too small (NOT capacity: filters^ regressed; NOT epochs: loss flat). Since lambda_t never moves from init, the init vn_lambda_init IS the lever. vn_lambda_init 0.0023 -> 0.05 makes data-consistency dominate the regulariser from step 1 so the recon stays anchored to the measured sinogram instead of over-smoothing. lr held (campaign has lr5e-4-optimal / 8e-4-worse on record). HYPOTHESIS: with the DC init ~22x stronger, val_ssim clears the FBP floor (val_ssim > 0.84, hr>0). FALSIFIER: if val_ssim stays <=0.84 (still <FBP), the VN regulariser is structurally degrading even under strong DC, and iter-4 must attack the regulariser itself (vn_normalize_filters=True to constrain filters zero-mean/unit-norm, or vn_init=backproj).
